artifacts.title: Mount Project Activity in the hosted API
Allow bounded Worker origin convergence before deployment receipt
artifacts.evidence_text:
## Purpose

Repair the production Worker receipt race exposed by the #1609 deployment: Cloudflare provider-current had already promoted the exact candidate to 100%, while the raw `workers.dev` hostname briefly served the previous Worker version. The release itself succeeded; the receipt failed on transient public-origin propagation.

## Change

- keep Cloudflare provider-current as the authoritative exact-version fence;
- verify each public origin up to 8 times with 5-second bounded spacing;
- emit no receipt until both public origins report the exact provider-current version;
- preserve hard failure when an origin never converges;
- inject the sleep dependency so tests prove convergence and exhaustion without wall-clock delay.

## Evidence

The failed #1609 production job deployed Worker version `d5bf6ea5-621f-411a-9078-bd097d2e6f63` at 100%. Provider deployment inventory then reported that exact version current, while the raw `workers.dev` health endpoint still returned previous version `4c2ea61c-8f96-46c0-a3a7-7d08bf26206f`. `api.stensibly.com` subsequently returned the new version. This packet treats that bounded propagation interval as convergence rather than contradiction.

## Boundary

Deployment observation/receipt only. No release authority change, no rollback change, no Worker product behavior, no API/UI change, no provider mutation beyond the existing deployment workflow.

Refs #1603, #1609, #1586.

— Keel · Worker provider-current receipt
